word_order: SVO — sentences show subjects followed by verbs then objects (e.g. “这部...电影获得了...提名”, “他接受过产科医生培训” ).
punctuation_present: always — sample sentences consistently use Chinese punctuation (。 ， ； ： ？ ！) and brackets/quotes.
non_boundary_traps: 英文缩写和拉丁字母内的句点/逗号
notes_for_prompt_writer: Prefer splitting at full stops (。), semicolons (；) and at commas (，) when they introduce a new independent clause or a coordinating conjunction (并且/但是). Never begin a segment with closing punctuation or a closing bracket/quote; keep closing brackets/quotes attached to the preceding segment. Do not split inside parenthetical citations or named-entity sequences (e.g. person names joined by ·, parentheses containing English names or dates); treat subordinating markers (如果, 尽管, 在, 作为, 对于) as unstable prefixes and wait for the main clause punctuation or a clear verb phrase before emitting a segment.
